source.title: A Hyaluronan-Based Injectable Hydrogel Improves the Survival and Integration of Stem Cell Progeny following Transplantation

material: HAMC (hyaluronan and methylcellulose blend) hydrogel, retinal stem cell-derived rod delivery

culture_days.evidence: the cells were exposed either to HAMC reconstituted in serum free media (SFM) or to SFM alone for 7 days.

other_outcomes.evidence: of approximately 10% constriction, demonstrating vision improvement (Figure 5I).
other_outcomes.name: maximum pupillary constriction in TKO mice receiving RSC-derived rods in HAMC+AAA

survival.evidence: The highest numbers of cells integrating into the neural retina were mature rods delivered in HAMC to mouse retinae pre-treated with AAA (380 ± 80, or 2.4%–4.3% of cells injected).

notes: Subretinal transplantation into adult mouse retina (retina); AAA pre-treatment to disrupt outer limiting membrane. Also in vitro culture in HAMC reconstituted in SFM.
